question: Why Turkey's trade offer of 7 September 1939 goes to Yugoslavia in the original and to Germany in the rewrite, and what follows from it.

addresses.name: CCountryTag::luabind_opeq
addresses.signature: void __cdecl CCountryTag::luabind_opeq(lua_State* L, CCountryTag* a, CCountryTag* b)
addresses.comment: The `__eq` the API registers for CCountryTag (ghidra/luabind.json, `void __eq(lua_State*,CCountryTag&,CCountryTag&)`): `lua_pushboolean(L, a->id (+4) == b->id)`. So two tags are equal by their country's id, whichever objects carry them - ai_trade.lua's `voFromTag == loDiploScoreObj.SellerTag`, a fresh copy against a route's tag, holds for the same country. Compare CFaction::luabind_opeq, by the faction's name token. Bare `ret` at 0x902A83 (VAs). FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 152.
addresses.evidence: The listing at VA 0x902A60-0x902A83: [ebp+0xC]+4 compared with [ebp+0x10]+4, sete, pushed with L to the import at [0xD2B534]; the registration's address 9448032 in ghidra/luabind.json.

addresses.name: CMapProvince::UsableNavalBaseLevel
addresses.comment:
The naval base's **current** level, in thousandths - or 0 for an owned port with a base whose sea province is in one particular sea region (the first entry of the sea province's +0x358 list equal to the global at 0x1A8558C) while WaterIsClosed says the water at the third pair of the defines' `map` block is shut to the province's owner. Which region that is was not established. What PortList_InsertByLevel orders an area's ports by. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-supplyconvoys.md, section 4.

**The region and the water, settled 2026-11-20 on the listing** (VA 0x4A7EE0-0x4A7F74): the level is the naval base's +0x24 (stored before any test); then, for an owned province (+0x330) with a CPort (+0x354) and a base whose level_max (+0x20) is positive, the port-sea's (+0xD4 -> +0xA4) first region is compared with the global at 0x1A8558C - **g_baltic_sea_region** (rva 0x168558C, the region named baltic_sea_region, SeaRegionsConnected's) - and the water asked of WaterIsClosed is the defines' `map` block +0x10, **BALTIC**, for the province's owner (+0x32C). So a Baltic port counts nought in its area's ranking while the Danish straits are held by an enemy of its owner: the Soviet Union's first harbour in July 1941 is not Leningrad. FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 152.
addresses.evidence: The listing at VA 0x4A7EE0-0x4A7F74; SeaRegionsConnected's record for the global; the defines' map block order (SUEZ, PANAMA, BALTIC, ...).
addresses.revises: comment - the region is the Baltic and the water BALTIC

addresses.name: ProcessAI
addresses.comment:
**One country's whole AI pass**, read whole on the listing (rva 0x4894E0 to the `ret 4` at 0x489BB5; two earlier `ret 4` exits at 0x489618 and 0x48986A with the body continuing past them - trap 3). In order: (1) nothing while `ai +0x128` (ai_paused, the console's AI pause) or the country's theatres_dirty (CCountry +0x580) is set; (2) the played country (`ai->id == gamestate->player`) has runs_units (+0x2C) cleared; (3) CEU3AI_RefreshUnitDestinations (0x49A800), AI_ManageUndergrounds (0x489E10); (4) a country owning no province and not in exile: CEU3AI_SendLandlessUnitsOnExpedition (0x499A10) and return; (5) firstPass = unit_pass_done (+0xA5) clear - but in a game loaded from a save (gamestate +0xD9C) firstPass is false and theatres_changed (+0xA6) is cleared; (6) every enabled minister on +0x74 is ticked (slot 9) and the foreign minister answers its offers (0x49E010); (7) the played country with automation[6] == 1: DeployFinishedUnits (0x48B300), every hour; (8) the played country of a loaded game with runs_units clear and no unit agent yet: CreateAgentsForPlannedUnits (0x48BEF0); (9) CEU3AI_DisbandTheatrelessHQs (0x489BD0) - a true answer ends the pass; (10) while theatres_changed is set, the strategy's theatres (CCountry +0x570, which is CAIStrategy +0xE4) are walked: the first whose `unit` does not resolve sends the pass on to (11); when every one resolves, CEU3AI_SortUnitsIntoTheatres(ai, isPlayer) - every unit put under the headquarters of the theatre it stands in, by posted detach and attach commands (FINDINGS-agents.md G) - theatres_changed cleared and **return**, so that hour ticks no agent; (11) every unit agent (+0x40) and every invasion agent (+0x50) is ticked through slot 9. Then with hour = (tick - 43800000) % 24 and the country id: (12) at hour 1 of the 1st of a month the failed-invasion areas (+0x94) are freed; at hour id%24 CEU3AI_AssignSeaTargetsToAgents (0x48C140); always CEU3AI_PruneInvasions (0x491BE0) into a local list; (13) a country whose runs_units is clear (the played one): on even hours, for each unit agent CEU3AI_RankInvasionAreas (0x495530) and CEU3AI::PlanAmphibiousInvasion (0x492190) with that agent - and nothing more; (14) every other country: CEU3AI_RecallStrandedLandUnits (0x498870) on the first pass or at hour (id+16)%24; CEU3AI::CreateAgentsForTheatres (0x48AA80); CEU3AI_BindAgentsAndAttachOrphans (0x48DCF0, whose answer is always false); at hour id%24 CEU3AI_ChoosePride (0x499C80), CEU3AI_BalanceDivisionsBetweenTheatres (0x48E490) where unit_pass_done is set, CEU3AI::RebuildPriorityProvinces (0x4976E0), RankInvasionAreas(ai, null), CEU3AI_RebuildWeakEnemyPorts (0x4972E0), CEU3AI::GenerateUnitObjectives (0x4980E0), PlanAmphibiousInvasion(ai, list, null); else at hour (id+8)%24 CEU3AI_GatherTransportsForTheatres (0x490DB0), DeployFinishedUnits, AI_ReassignLeaders (0x498EF0); else at hour (id+16)%24 every unit agent's per-type tally (CAIUnit +0x23C) zeroed, CEU3AI_DistributeFleetsToTheatres (0x48FBB0), CEU3AI_DistributeAirToTheatres (0x48F2B0), and CEU3AI_PromoteLeadersForCommands (0x499280); then CEU3AI::UpdateUnitStances(ai, hour == (id+16)%24) and unit_pass_done = 1. Callers: RunAIPass's tbb parallel_for, once a game hour from the frame after the hour turns; CInGameIdler::Enter for a game loaded from a save; a once-per-process multiplayer kick; idler slot 67 (FINDINGS-ai.md). **A single-player new game runs none of it during its two days and first hour.** See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-agents.md, section A. **A game just loaded runs two passes for every country at its own hour, before its first hour** (counted in the running game on a save of July 1941, 2026-11-10: 204 passes for 102 countries, all at the save's tick, agent ticks 192 for 96 agents, land blocks 96). Every agent is already there when the first pass begins; unit_pass_done reads 0 and theatres_changed 1 on the first pass and 1 and 0 on the second. Which of the two runs the land block was not logged. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 12. **Each of a load's two passes is a country's whole pass, its ministers ticked in both** (recorded on the running game, 2026-11-16, FINDINGS-liveread.md section 106): the first on the main thread, all 102 countries in the list's order, the second on the worker threads; a minister whose countdown runs out in either and whose hour of the day is the save's works there - at 07:00 on 16 July 1941 Holland's foreign minister (CAIForeignMinister::ExecuteDiploDecisions' scope draw and six of the Lua's `math.random`) and Greece's politics minister (four CCurrentGameState_GetAIRand), both in the second pass, the AI generator's draws 505 to 509. **The hour's passes race** (recorded on the running game, 2026-11-16, FINDINGS-liveread.md section 111): over 72 hours of July 1941 the main thread ran the same six every hour - `---`, REB, Germany, Britain, the Soviet Union and the United States, the first six of the country list - and the rest went to worker threads, Tannu Tuva's beginning before the Soviet Union's in 53 hours and after it in 19. Since CEU3AI::MoveUnit writes a unit's +0x2CC at once, an agent counting an ally's units (CAIUnit::CountUnitsAtPositions' allies half) sees that ally's orders of the hour or not as the threads fall.

**The worker threads' x87 runs at 24 bits** (the running game, 2026-11-20): each of the 31 worker threads caught entering ProcessAI holds the control word 0x007F (24-bit precision, round to nearest, all exceptions masked), read through Wow64GetThreadContext; 44 of the process's 76 threads hold 0x027F. So the AI's Lua runs its arithmetic in single-precision mantissas on the workers too, as on the device's thread (FINDINGS-luahost.md, section 6, where whether TBB carried the control word was left unread; TBB 3.0, 2011, ships with the game): ai_trade.lua's `DailyBalance - Buffer` comes out as the float, and a buyer whose money asked equals what it may spend to the thousandth passes the test. FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 152.
addresses.evidence: Breakpoint on ProcessAI's entry over a few hours of Ireland1939_09_06_18, each hit's ESP matched to a thread's stack; each thread's WOW64_CONTEXT read with CONTEXT_FLOATING_POINT, FloatSave.ControlWord.
addresses.revises: comment - the AI's threads run the x87 at 24 bits

addresses.name: RunCountryDailyPass
addresses.comment:
**Everything a country does once a day**, not just politics: 0x4DA530 to the `ret 4` at 0x4DC239 **and cold blocks after it up to 0x4DC404** - corrected 2026-10-13, this said '0x4DC242 onward is SEH unwind, not body': 0x4DC23C..0x4DC24C and 0x4DC3E8..0x4DC3F8 are catch funclets (ReportLuaError, then a continuation address), but 0x4DC24D..0x4DC3E3 is body, reached by `je 0x4DC24F` at 0x4DC15B - the AI's call of BalanceProductionSliders and **BalanceLendLeaseSliders** (0x510160, 0x510210) - and 0x4DC3F9/0x4DC3FF are loop tails jumped to from 0x4DB9A0 and 0x4DA8F9 (trap 3). One caller, RunDailyPass at 0x682E1A, looping the country vector; the address is in no vftable. Phases: three unread helpers, then Neutrality clamped to [0,100000] and EffectiveNeutrality derived; convoys and lend-lease; CCountry::ChangeNeutrality by the NEUTRALITY_CHANGE modifier; the IC block; the daily influence upkeep and then dissent forced to 0 for REB; the underground; elections; surrender; the AI. Alignment drift at 0x4DB87E, every ALIGNMENT_INTERVAL days. See FINDINGS-politics.md for the full ordered table.

**The daily look at a country's convoys** (0x4DABDF on, read 2026-11-20): for a trade convoy (+0xA0) the partner is **whoever holds its far end** (+0xC4's controller, +0x338), or its start's (+0xC0) where the owner holds the far end; the convoy is kept only where one of the owner's routes with that partner (diplomacy[partner] +0x60) names it (0xA9D390 on the route's +0x7C/+0x80). So a harbour the partner has lost to a third country, at war with nobody, takes the convoy away and its route dies next for want of it. The war and rebel tests follow at 0x4DACFA. And since the whole pass runs one country before the next, a route an earlier country runs is paid before a later country's look takes the convoy away, and a convoy an earlier country's maintenance (step 10) mans carries the later countries' trade the same day. FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 152.
addresses.evidence: The listing at VA 0x4DABDF-0x4DAD52; The running game, 2026-11-20, Ireland1939_09_06_18 and the recording wz3 (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 152).
addresses.revises: comment - the trade convoy look's partner is the far end's holder; the pass's order decides which routes pay
